Technology Stack

Production-Grade
Optical Protocol

Every layer engineered for real-world reliability — from GPU rendering to cryptographic integrity verification.

⚡Phase 4

Adaptive Optical Engine

Real-time mode selection scoring FPS, thermal state, battery level, and error rate to pick the optimal transmission channel per second.

🔒Phase 1

AES-256-GCM Encryption

Every packet is encrypted with AES-256-GCM before encoding. ECDH key exchange with forward secrecy. Secure Enclave / KeyStore key storage.

🔄Phase 3

Reed-Solomon + Fountain FEC

Dual-layer error correction: RS(255, K) for symbol-level recovery, LT fountain codes for packet-level recovery without retransmissions.

📡All Phases

5 Optical Transmission Modes

Dynamic QR (10 KB/frame), RGB LSB modulation (50 KB/frame), invisible flicker (100 KB/frame), rolling shutter exploitation, and parallel MUX.

🎯Phase 2

GPU-Accelerated Rendering

Metal (iOS) and Vulkan (Android) pipeline for sub-millisecond frame encoding. V-sync locked output at up to 240 FPS.

🔧Phase 3

3-Way Optical Handshake

Mutual device identification, protocol version negotiation, and capability exchange over optical channel before data transfer begins.
